children: BRC agreed to acquire Sangoma Technologies in a deal that values Sangoma at $204 million.

Sangoma shareholders will receive $4.93 per share and about 0.048 of a BRC share as part of the deal. Based on the 20-day average price of BRC, the planned deal implies a value of about $5.23 per Sangoma share, BRC said Monday.
Once the deal is complete, Sangoma shareholders will collectively hold about 4% of BRC's stock.
The deal is the result of a strategic review announced in May and undertaken by a committee of independent directors at Sangoma.
Sangoma will operate as part of BRC Telecom, which is a portfolio of communications businesses backed by BRC.
The agreement includes a provision for a $5.4 million termination fee to end the deal and accept an unsolicited superior proposal if BRC doesn't elect to exercise its right to match such an offer.
